app.name: Assistant Cabinet AI
app.subtitle: Administrative assistance on your computer. Check the answers: the practitioner remains the sole decision maker.

settings.title: Settings
settings.legalModuleDescription: Planned: it will be added here, country by country, like the health module.
settings.layoutDescription: Puts the folders, the workspace and the conversation back to their original widths.
settings.explorerDensityDescription: The height of a row in the file list of the left panel.
settings.resetDescription: Puts every setting back to how it started, including the choice of documents folder.
settings.resetBody: The theme, the language, the layout of the zones, the AI address, the models, the idle timeout and the choice of documents folder will all go back to how they started. Your documents and their analysis are not deleted: choosing the same folder again finds them exactly as they were.
settings.languageDescription: The interface, the messages and the language the answers are written in.
settings.serverUrlDescription: The practice AI. Never a public service.
settings.modelAliasDescription: Which profile answers. The list comes from the AI.
settings.modelAliasUnavailable: The AI has not listed its profiles yet.
settings.idleTimeoutDescription: How long to wait when the AI goes quiet, in seconds. A long answer is never cut off while it is still being written; this only ends the wait when nothing arrives at all. Raise it on a slower computer or with a larger model.
settings.generatedFolderDescription: The subfolder of your documents folder where letters made from a template and a spreadsheet are written. The name is simplified: letters without accents, digits, hyphens.
settings.knowledgeModeDescription: Finds the names of people and organisations in your documents to reach the right files faster. Everything stays on this computer. “Off” reads no name. “Suggestions only” never narrows the search by itself: you can choose a name to target it. “Automatic” limits the search to the files that mention the names in the question, with a button to search everything. Names are read at the next analysis you start.
settings.healthModuleDescription: Tick the country or countries of your patients: a cross-border worker can have both a French social security number and an AVS number. A module helps read the numbers and vocabulary of its country, and never removes or changes the type of a name. Applied at the next analysis you start.
settings.timingLogLabel: Write the timings to a log
settings.timingLogDescription: Writes, on this computer only, how long each question and each analysis takes: durations and numbers, never your question, a file name or an excerpt. Off by default; switch it on for a measurement.
settings.showDiagnosticsDescription: Under the last answer, shows the timings and what the knowledge base recognised and left out. For developers: numbers and codes, never your questions or file names.
settings.copySourcesLabel: Also copy the sources of answers
settings.copySourcesDescription: The “Copy” and “Copy the conversation” buttons add, under each answer, the list of its sources (files, pages, sheets and columns).
settings.hideNamesDescription: Suggested questions quote no name: a screen can be seen from the waiting room.
settings.minScopeFilesLabel: Minimum number of files to target
settings.minScopeFilesDescription: Below this many chosen files the search is never narrowed by itself. A name you choose narrows the search whatever the size.
settings.maxSelectivityLabel: Largest share of files for a name to target
settings.maxSelectivityDescription: A name found in more than this share of your files (yours, the practice's) points at no file in particular and is ignored.
settings.minReductionLabel: Smallest share of files left out
settings.minReductionDescription: The search is narrowed only if it leaves out at least this share of the chosen files.
settings.maxCandidatesDescription: At most this many documents are searched after a targeting. Workbooks are not limited.
settings.widenBelowScoreDescription: If the closest passage found in the targeted files resembles the question less than this score (0 to 1.5), the search is repeated on your whole selection. The scale depends on the reading model: 0.65 was measured with nomic-embed-text.
settings.manageKnowledgeDescription: See what the base found and where it comes from, add a name, merge, split or delete an entity, or reset the base.

credits.title: Credits and licences of the voice
credits.intro: The voice uses the open components below. The models and the voices are downloaded only when you press Install, and each voice shows the state of its licence.

component.parakeet: Speech recognition uses NVIDIA Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3 (nvidia/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3), © NVIDIA, licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International licence (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). The weights are used in an int8-quantised ONNX conversion published with sherpa-onnx (k2-fsa); no other change was made.
component.sherpa: The speech recognition program and the reading program run on sherpa-onnx (k2-fsa, Apache-2.0 licence, https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx) and on ONNX Runtime (MIT licence). Both are built into those two programs and into nothing else.
component.espeak: The Piper voices read their text through the phonemizer espeak-ng (GPL-3.0 licence, https://github.com/espeak-ng/espeak-ng). It is built into one separate program, the reading program, and nowhere else in the application; the notice of that program, speech-tts-worker-NOTICE.md, is installed next to it. The phonemizer data is not part of the installer: each voice brings its own copy.
component.voices: The Piper voices come from the rhasspy/piper-voices collection (https://huggingface.co/rhasspy/piper-voices) and the voice css10 from neongeckocom/tts-vits-css10-fr (https://huggingface.co/neongeckocom/tts-vits-css10-fr). Each voice has its own licence, listed below.

voice.siwis: French female voice, Piper fr_FR siwis medium: SIWIS French Speech Synthesis Database (CC BY 4.0), phonemizer espeak-ng (GPL-3.0). It was fine-tuned from a voice whose training data is for research only.
voice.css10: French male voice, Coqui VITS css10: BSD-3-Clause licence, trained on CSS10 French (LibriVox recordings, public domain).
voice.ljspeech: English voice, Piper en_US ljspeech medium: LJ Speech recordings (public domain), phonemizer espeak-ng (GPL-3.0).
voice.libritts_r: English voice, Piper en_US libritts_r medium: LibriTTS-R (CC BY 4.0), phonemizer espeak-ng (GPL-3.0).

You can ask for the total per group, or for the rows above a threshold.
nudge.value_not_found: “{value}” does not match any real value in {file}.

manage.title: Knowledge
manage.intro: What the application found in the analysed documents and spreadsheets: people, organisations, places, identifiers. Nothing here changes, moves or deletes a file in your folders.
manage.offNote: The knowledge base is switched off in Settings: what you change here will only be used once the mode is switched back on.
manage.inconsistent: The base reports an internal inconsistency. Your files are not affected: reset the base (the “Reset” tab) or report it.
manage.pendingOne: {count} document will be read again at the next analysis, from the text already stored: the AI is not asked.
manage.pendingMany: {count} documents will be read again at the next analysis, from the text already stored: the AI is not asked.

sheet.deleted: This entity was deleted: it no longer appears and the analysis does not create it again.

sheet.nameHint: This name will be looked for in your documents at the next analysis.

sheet.nameSharedMany: This name is already recognised for {count} other entities: a question that uses it will ask you which one.

sheet.provenanceIntro: Each line says where the application found this entity and what it relied on.

sheet.columns: How the spreadsheet columns were read
sheet.loadFailed: This sheet could not be read.

merge.searchHint: Only entities of the same type can be merged.
merge.none: No entity of the same type matches.

split.hint: Useful when two different people carry the same name. In “Where this entity comes from”, tick the mentions that concern the other person, give them a name, then confirm.
split.nameNote: This name must differ from every name the base knows.
split.pickSome: Tick at least one mention, but not all of them.

delete.title: Delete “{name}”?
delete.body: The entity disappears from the lists and the analysis does not create it again. Your files are not touched. You can restore it under “Deleted entities”.

merge.title: Merge these two entities?
merge.body: “{absorbed}” becomes another name of “{survivor}”. Nothing is moved: you can undo the merge.

split.title: Split {count} mention(s) off “{name}”?
split.body: They move to a new entity, “{newName}”. You can undo this split right afterwards. Your files are not touched.

removeAlias.title: Remove this name?
removeAlias.body: “{name}” will no longer be recognised for this entity. “Undo” cannot bring it back, but you can add it again.

removeAttribute.title: Remove this detail?
removeAttribute.body: The pronunciation “{name}” is removed from this entity.

reset.title: Reset what the files taught?
reset.body: The entities found in your documents and spreadsheets are erased. What you typed by hand and the entities you deleted are kept. The next analysis reads the already analysed documents again, without asking the AI. Your files are not touched.

resetAll.title: Reset everything?
resetAll.body: The whole knowledge base is emptied: found entities, entities typed by hand, added names, details, deleted entities and the history of operations. This cannot be undone. Your files are not touched.

review.pairsIntro: Two entities that perhaps are the same, without it being certain. Nothing is merged without your agreement.
review.healthIntro: Numbers to spot what deserves a look. Nothing is corrected by itself.
review.candidates: Entities to confirm (found with no sure support)
review.documentsWithoutEntity: Documents where no name was found
review.workbooksWithoutColumn: Spreadsheets where no column was read as a name, a place or an identifier
review.inDocumentsNotInTables: People and organisations cited in documents but in no spreadsheet
review.showEntities: Show them in the Entities tab
review.loadFailed: This part could not be read.

types.intro: The vocabulary the base uses. It is not edited here.

reset.intro: The knowledge base holds only names and locations, never your files. The “Erase the analysis” entry in each folder’s menu empties that folder’s analysis; this one empties the knowledge base itself.
reset.keepBody: Erases the entities found in your documents and spreadsheets. Keeps what you typed by hand (entities, names, details) and the entities you deleted, which will not come back.
reset.allBody: Also erases the entities typed by hand, the added names, the details, the deleted entities and the history of operations.
reset.after: Either way, the next analysis rebuilds the base from the text already stored: the AI is not asked and your files are never touched.
